title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: At the PC: press Esc (or click the desktop) to shut the Windows clipboard panel at the bottom left; then in Marvelous, File, Quit, and No to saving. Then tap Done.
sections.recommendation: Do it when you are next at the PC: about a minute. The panel keeps the game from coming to the front, so last night's walk never started and today's game runs wait on it. No web link: the answer is this page.
